name: sac-codes
description: SAC (services accounting) codes a freelancer or small business commonly bills under, with the GST rate on each, from Notification 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate) as amended by 15/2025 (22 September 2025) and 06/2026 (1 November 2026). Rates are total GST: the notification states central tax (2.5 means 5% GST, 9 means 18% GST). Service descriptions are from the Annexure to that notification (Scheme of Classification of Services). Every earlier amendment to the notification (25 of them, 2017 to 2025) was read to confirm the serials whose rate predates 2025. Coverage runs to the end of FY 2026-27 because nothing further is notified for it; re-check after any GST Council meeting.

sources.title: Notification 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate) dated 28 June 2017, Table of service rates
sources.notes: The base rate table, and the source of every entry that cites a serial number. Later amendments are listed in the 'svc2017to2025' source below.

sources.title: Amendments to Notification 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate) issued from 2017 to 2025
sources.notes: The Council's official list of rate notifications. All 25 notifications amending 11/2017 up to 2025 were downloaded and read. Of the serials used here: 16 was substituted by 01/2018 (item (iii), real estate services other than the land items, 9%), 23 by 01/2018 (item (iii) residual, 9%), 25 by 01/2018 (item (ii) residual, 9%) with aircraft and ship MRO added at 2.5% by 02/2020 and 02/2021; serials 20 and 30 were never amended. 15/2025 and 06/2026 touch neither.

sources.title: Notification 15/2025-Central Tax (Rate) dated 17 September 2025, effective 22 September 2025
sources.notes: GST 2.0 services amendment: serial 21(ii) 9% central tax, serial 26 rewritten (job work and tailoring), serial 35 rewritten (beauty 2.5%), serial 12 rewritten (postal, courier, delivery 9%). Gazette G.S.R. 663(E).

sources.title: Notification 06/2026-Central Tax (Rate) dated 27 October 2026, effective 1 November 2026
sources.notes: 57th GST Council changes: serial 12(iii) delivery services cut from 9% to 2.5% central tax; hotels, restaurants and electric-vehicle transport reworded. Gazette G.S.R. 936(E).

sources.title: Annexure: Scheme of Classification of Services (SAC code descriptions), Notification 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate)
sources.notes: Where every six-digit code and its wording come from. The code identifies the service; the rate comes from the Table above, read at heading level unless an item narrows it.

sources.title: FAQs on the decisions of the 56th GST Council, 3 September 2025
sources.notes: Council's own explanation of the 5%/18% structure and of the service entries that changed (Q58-72: transport, job work, hotels, beauty).
